objective: Official valid Macro-AUC >= 0.82 without per-class weight or threshold search; never below the delivered 0.816830 floor.

member_descriptions.B: Base768 E10 best EMA from 040; existing 0.810570 valid single model.
member_descriptions.B2: New Base768 P3 student, seed 45, fixed 12-epoch cosine, final EMA (last.pt); selected without valid.
member_descriptions.A: Tiny768 E9 best EMA from 039; existing 0.809116 valid single model.

rules.name: R1_B_B2_equal
rules.purpose: Primary simple two-Base seed ensemble; class 1-10 equal.

rules.name: R2_B_B2_A_class1_base
rules.purpose: Primary full ensemble: class 1 is the two-Base mean; classes 2-10 equal over B, B2, A.

latency_fallback_rule.name: R2b_A_identity
latency_fallback_rule.description: Same probability rule as R2, but member A runs identity only. Evaluated only if R2 is the top rule and its measured mean exceeds the latency gate.

decision_gates.if_best_valid_between_0_818_and_0_82: User pre-approved one additional pre-registered B2 variant with stronger augmentation; no per-class search.
decision_gates.if_best_valid_below_0_818: Do not ship a new rule below the 0.816830 floor; report and decide with the user.

constraints.max_members: 2 Base + 1 Tiny (421.9 MB); 3 Base exceed the 500 MB limit
constraints.test_role: final prediction only; never used for selection, fitting or statistics
constraints.valid_role: read-only evaluation of the pre-registered rules after training
